selected_bottleneck: apply-persisted-pathset-integrity（应用持久化路径集合完整性）
selected_problem: Fresh canonical main rejected duplicate and overlapping change paths while staging, but apply trusted the persisted path set after reload. A duplicated path could be applied and only make rollback fail later on duplicate receipt identity; a coherently rewritten overlapping path set could pass preflight and then fail during the second write after the first write had already mutated the workspace.
decision_basis: Duplicate and overlapping path rejection are already explicit stage-time invariants, so revalidating the same path-set constraints at apply is protocol preservation rather than a new path policy.

The overlap case is directly falsifiable and demonstrated partial side effects: the first write created src/dir, then the second nested write failed with EEXIST because the persisted path set no longer satisfied the stage invariant.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502; this cycle used DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY（DWAC 源码契约重放） and exact local focused validation.

pre_fix_reality.duplicate_case: EXPECTED_FAILURE: apply accepted a duplicated persisted change path and mutated the workspace.
pre_fix_reality.overlap_case: EXPECTED_FAILURE: apply raised a filesystem EEXIST only after the first overlapping write had already changed the workspace.
pre_fix_reality.impact: A persisted STAGED artifact could lose the stage-time path-set invariant and become non-reversible or partially applied.

change: Apply now rebuilds the seen-path set during preflight and rejects duplicate or ancestor/descendant-overlapping persisted change paths before operation, preimage, postimage, or workspace mutation logic proceeds.

validation.node_check: PASS on the exact proposed core/changesets.mjs content
validation.focused_tests: 6/6 PASS, 0 skipped across apply-preimage, apply-operation, and apply-pathset integrity
validation.pre_fix_regressions: Both duplicate and overlap cases reproduced before the fix
validation.no_partial_write: PASS: overlap rejection occurs before src/dir or its child is created

truth_boundary: This revalidates duplicate/overlap constraints for the persisted path strings already produced by stage. It does not yet claim canonical-path spelling integrity against a coherently rewritten alias path or authenticated artifact integrity.
